Name: Cyolo
Author: Cyolo - support@cyolo.io
Description: The [Cyolo](https://www.cyolo.io/) solution for Microsoft Sentinel contains two CCF-based data connectors that ingest Cyolo Zero-Trust Access logs into your Microsoft Sentinel workspace: activity logs (user access events, authentication, and sessions) and audit logs (administrative actions, configuration changes, and compliance events). Each connector can be enabled independently.
